name: Plugin switches
author: Brett
description: A pop-up dialog with a simple list of every plugin and a switch to turn each one on or off. Its own switch is greyed out, so it can't switch itself off from its own list. Warns when switching off a plugin that another running plugin needs. Open it from the right-click / long-press menu anywhere, the action plugin-switches.open, search, or Settings → Plugins → Plugin switches.
